purpose: Source-backed competitive comparator ledger for Verified Household Services. Manufacturer-declared specifications and announced product features are not independent physical test results.
claim_ceiling: Manufacturer product fiches are source evidence for what the manufacturer declares, not independent performance verification.
Numbers from different programmes, markets, standards editions or loading protocols are not directly comparable without a matched test.
Announced products and concept studies are roadmap/context evidence, not purchasable test units.
Null metrics mean no applicable public quantitative value was found in the cited source; they must not be imputed.

notes: The fiche also contains a manufacturer endurance statement; that is not a warranty or field-derived lifetime reliability distribution.
